axis_convention: Baked rings are a local PLAN frame in metres: x = easting - origin.x, y = northing - origin.y. The renderer supplies the Y-up step with rotateX(-PI/2), which is the same one-line move packages/engine/solum_massing/solid.py -> web/src/components/Scene.tsx already makes. Keeping the bake in plan means a district and a plot study cannot end up mirrored against each other.

sun.basis: NOAA solar position algorithm from the AOI centroid

imagery.frame: local plan metres (east, north) from origin — NW, NE, SE, SW
